lines.speaker: night_clerk
lines.text: Four of them signed for a counterparty rather than a company. A counterparty is what you sign for when the thing you represent is not a person and not a firm.

lines.speaker: night_clerk
lines.text: That is the name, yes. And the register entry cites an enabling act from 2031 that I have never been able to find a debate for.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: There wasn't much of one. I was there.
